description: Operational annotation-derived benchmark label. AMP denotes a qualifying GenPept AMP annotation under the documented labeling rule; non-AMP denotes annotation-negative/unlabeled comparison records and must not be interpreted as experimentally confirmed inactivity.
Amino-acid sequence supplied for benchmark use.
Length of sequence in amino-acid residues.
Unique row-level identifier retained for release traceability.
Normalized amino-acid sequence used by the curation/evaluation pipeline. In v1.1 it equals sequence for all 11,000 rows.
Length of sequence_clean. In v1.1 it equals length for all 11,000 rows.
Sequence-clustering identifier retained from the processing workflow; not a biological-family label.
Operational high-identity connected-component identifier used for component-aware partition control; not a biological-family identifier.
Authoritative canonical partition assignment. This is the only field that defines the benchmark partition.
Length stratum used in partitioning and robustness analyses.
